


# Developer mode


Necessary to change output layout of quotes and invoices for example

Activate with:

      1. Settings App
      2. General Settings
      3. Activate the developer mode




# Unit of measure

Activate one time

> So do this first:
> 1. Sales → Configuration → Settings.
> 2. Under Product Catalog, tick Units of Measure → Save.
> 3. Come back to this product page → the Unit of Measure field will now appear → set it to Days.

- Unit

  > Tip — set it once on the product instead: Since this is a service you bill
  > per day, open the product  → General Information tab → set Unit of Measure
  > = Days. Then every new quote line defaults to Days and you won't have to
  > change it each time.
